name: Avarenol
description: Avarenol is Lazarus's flagship bliss compound — a slow-release oral formulation producing a sustained, gentle, all-pervading sense of well-being and contentment that lasts a full day without peaks or crashes. It doesn't make you high; it makes you feel like everything is fundamentally fine. Developed for chronic depression and existential anxiety in a population living under significant systemic pressure, it has become one of the most widely used recreational substances in GLMZ.
effects: Sustained, gentle, pervasive sense of well-being and contentment
Reduction of existential anxiety and background dread
No perceptual distortion — fully functional throughout
side_effects: Reduced motivation to change circumstances — contentment can suppress problem-solving drive
Emotional flattening — joy is also muted, not just suffering
Dependency develops quickly with daily use
Rare: 'acceptance syndrome' — users become unable to feel urgency about genuinely urgent things
street_price: Φ 15 per dose (generic); Φ 40 per dose (Lazarus branded)
cultural_context: Avarenol is the most politically contested drug in GLMZ. Critics — especially the Gray Zone activists and labor organizers — call it a compliance drug, a chemical that makes people feel okay about conditions that should make them furious. Lazarus counters that chronic existential suffering is a genuine medical condition and that Avarenol treats it. Both are correct. On the Gray Zone, generic Avarenol is so cheap and so effective that some community health workers distribute it as harm reduction — better bliss than the alternatives. In Tier 5, a premium Lazarus formulation called Avarenol Aurum costs Φ 400 per dose and reportedly produces a qualitatively richer contentment.
story_hooks: A the Gray Zone organizer trying to build a labor action has discovered that half her community is on daily Avarenol and genuinely doesn't feel the urgency she needs them to feel — she has to decide whether to campaign against the drug or find a way to work around it

The generic Avarenol flooding the Gray Zone is slightly off-formula — it works, but it also contains a trace compound that Lazarus's lawyers are calling a 'manufacturing variance' and that a street chemist is calling deliberate, because the variance degrades motivation specifically for collective action while leaving individual contentment intact

A Tier 4 executive has been secretly taking Avarenol for two years and has stopped flagging problems to her superiors because everything feels fine — a genuine crisis in her division has been quietly accepted rather than escalated, and it's about to become everyone's problem
